description: Re-run AI analysis on an already-uploaded document: extracts the text from the stored file, stores it (get_document_text reads it back), replaces its search sections (search_knowledge finds them, source = document_id + sheet/rows) and writes/refreshes the AI-summary section of description. Required: document_id. Only works on documents with an uploaded file (via upload_document), not url-only references. Text extraction supports PDF, Word .docx, Excel .xlsx (per sheet as Markdown table), PowerPoint/OpenDocument and txt/md/csv/json/html; use it to (re)process files uploaded before Office support existed. Returns { ok, description, summary, text_stored, text_chars, indexed_sections, vectorised_sections, index_error? }.
name: analyze_document
